name: The History of Anime and Manga: A Crash Course
source:
You and your classmates are going to be taking a special class on anime and manga. Your team (You, Hiro, and Mika) are assigned to report on its history, so that you'll be ready for a big test at the end of Day Three of the class.

This game features:
-Four different grades/endings
-Four characters including yourself
-Lots of information, presented (hopefully) in an immersive and fun style
-The ability to name the protagonist

[Edited from [url=http://renai.us/game/anime_history101.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
你和同学们即将参加一堂关于动画与漫画的特别课程。你所在的小组由你、希罗和米卡组成，负责介绍动画与漫画的历史，并为课程第三天结束时的大考做好准备。

游戏特色：
-四种不同的成绩与结局。
-包括你在内的四名角色。
-大量知识，以尽量引人入胜、有趣的方式呈现。
-可自行为主人公命名。

[编译自[url=http://renai.us/game/anime_history101.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
